🔥 gods-eye-view | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Providing users with a real-time, interactive, and visually rich platform for exploring live global data streams, simulating a spy satellite's perspective for situational awareness and intelligence gathering.
✨ Key Features: • Photorealistic 3D globe visualization • Live tracking of aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras
📖 Summary: God's Eye View is a web-based spy satellite simulator that provides live, open-source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe. It integrates real-time data from aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras, offering a hands-free voice control interface powered by an AI agent.
